title: delta-explain report (schema_version 0.3.x)
description: The JSON document emitted by `delta-explain --format json`. This schema is strict (additionalProperties: false) and describes schema_version 0.3.x exactly; consumers should tolerate unknown fields at runtime, since additive changes bump the minor and ship as a new schema file.

schema_version.description: Version of this document's schema, independent of the tool version. Additive changes bump the minor, breaking changes bump the major.

tool_version.description: The delta-explain release that produced the report.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the whole analysis.

table.description: The table path or URI exactly as given on the command line.

version.description: The Delta snapshot version analyzed (affected by --at-version).

predicate.description: The WHERE predicate as given, or null when no --where was passed.

total_files.description: Files in the snapshot before any pruning.

final_files.description: Files surviving the last phase; equals total_files when there is no predicate.

analysis.description: Predicate classification; null when no --where was passed.

partition_safe.description: Conjuncts that prune at directory level (rendered from the normalized AST).

partition_exact.description: Conjuncts outside the kernel predicate language whose columns are all partition columns and whose semantics are fully known; evaluated exactly, per file, against the literal partition values.

stats_safe.description: Conjuncts that prune on min/max file statistics.

unsplittable.description: Conjuncts that cannot be attributed to a single phase; applied conservatively.

notes.description: Analyzer diagnostics. Stable codes: UNSPLITTABLE_OR, UNSUPPORTED_EXPRESSION, PARTITION_EVAL_GAP.

table_features.description: Detect-and-declare block for protocol features that reframe the numbers. Declarative only: the numbers are never compensated.

files_with_deletion_vectors.description: Files in the snapshot actually carrying a deletion vector. When > 0, record counts include soft-deleted rows.

column_mapping_mode.description: Column mapping mode, or null when mapping is absent.

clustering_columns.description: Liquid clustering columns (dotted paths); empty array when the table is clustered but the domain payload is unreadable; null when not clustered. Undetectable on fully checkpointed logs.

notes.description: Table-level warnings. Stable codes: DELETION_VECTORS, COLUMN_MAPPING, LIQUID_CLUSTERING.

in_commit_timestamps.description: delta.enableInCommitTimestamps or the inCommitTimestamp writer feature. Declared for completeness; nothing this tool reports depends on it.

unrecognized_writer_features.description: Writer features outside the set known to be irrelevant to the reported numbers; each earns an UNRECOGNIZED_TABLE_FEATURE warning.

mode.description: Per-table statistics coverage. Reflects the indexed columns, not per-predicate reachability.

phases.description: Chained pruning phases in execution order; each phase's survivors feed the next. Empty when no predicate was given.

name.description: Phase identifier; also the value files[].pruned_by refers to.

predicate.description: The normalized fragment this phase evaluated.

assertions.description: One entry per CI gate that ran; empty when no gate flags were passed.

result.description: Overall assertion outcome: null when no gates ran; fail also makes the process exit 1.

files.description: Per-file outcomes; present only with --verbose, capped by --limit.

path.description: File path relative to the table root, as recorded in the log.

num_records.description: From the file's statistics; includes soft-deleted rows on files with deletion vectors. Null when the file carries no stats.

kept.description: True when the file survives every phase. The set of kept files is the survivor set, guaranteed to be a superset of the files any engine needs.

pruned_by.description: Name of the first phase that eliminated the file, or null when kept.

files_truncated.description: Present only with --verbose: true when --limit cut the files array short.

confidence.description: exact: the phase's file elimination is precise. conservative: sound but may keep extra files (min/max ranges overlap without containing matches). incomplete: part of the predicate could not be attributed; numbers are still sound but under-explained.

code.description: Stable machine-readable identifier. New codes are additive (minor bump).
